name: @shiguang/ai
description: 拾光智能层：Mastra 分析编排 + SQLite 数据访问层

scripts.postinstall: node -e "const path=require('path');const paths=[process.cwd(),path.resolve(process.cwd(),'..'),path.resolve(process.cwd(),'../..'),path.resolve(process.cwd(),'../../apps/desktop')];let v=null;for(const p of paths){try{v=require(require.resolve('electron/package.json',{paths:[p]})).version;break}catch(e){}}if(!v){console.log('[@shiguang/ai] electron not found, skip better-sqlite3 ABI rebuild');process.exit(0)}require('child_process').execSync('electron-rebuild -v '+v+' -f -w better-sqlite3',{stdio:'inherit'})"
